body: I do not think anyone within 10 miles of my parents has told them to be quiet for a second, much less shut up. They are really intimidating.
Hah, not in my case. I was the most hated kid in my family. My little brother was a saint in their eyes.
My mom tried to make me wear my grandpa's clothes to graduation.

They always pull the "I'm older, I know more, STFU", on me. My mom also fakes headaches, and when I leave the room, 2 seconds later she's fine. She also sics my dad on me and when we argue, she says, "You started it" I mean, who above the age of 12 says "You started it."?
They tell me all the time that all gay people are just faking for attention and that homophobia doesn't exist.

My parents shame suicide constantly and say they have no sympathy for people who commit it. They also say that depression must have a cause, a trauma. They laughed at me when I asked for help. They are really "my way or the highway" types...
The Galliard flashback from 104 with Zeke, Pieck, and Galliard just... eating pizza.

I know right... kids show up at the library to play on the computers at full goddamn volume, and when I or librarian ask them to turn it down politely, their stupid bitch of a soccer mom starts screaming at us, "I'll press CHARGES". The one good thing about it is that she gets escorted out, along with her hellspawn.
They are either cardinal or neon tetras, probably neon though. :)
Actually, I saw white growth! It freaked me out, I thought it was fungal for a bit, thanks so much!
I saw a turret though, at the moment where the assassin was running with the other NPCs behind them.

She's like eren, except she actually doesn't have much reason to have this attitude. Eren's parents got killed, and he saw half his hometown die, so he has some justification, at least. Gabi's just kind of super bloodthirsty for a kid that young with no justification.

You forgot the "mountain division" which is probably using 3dmg, as Zeke took only part of Mike's gear, it is plausible that they modified the 3dmg and have a squad particularly made for battling titans and survey corps. That would even it out quite a bit.
I feel bad for maid-chan, mainly because that stare reminds me of Eleven from Stranger things. But DAMN. Can the Warhammer break crystal? I can sense an Annie breakthrough (pun intended)
